svg.aria-label: AquaSentinel: a float on a guide pole at a bridge pier. A spill drifts in, the beacon turns red and an SMS alert goes out.

g.text: A river that raises its own alarm.
Reads the water every 15 minutes · decides on board · warns the bank · bottles the spill

pH 6.6 · TDS 1,620 ppm ▲ · turbidity 31 NTU · 27.8 °C · INDUSTRIAL
Limit 1,400 ppm · class INDUSTRIAL · beacon RED
Sample bottled for the lab. Close the intake.
